allowed_clients.description: List of client networks/IPs (CIDR or single IP) allowed to connect.

listen.description: Network interface or IP to bind the daemon to.

max_jobs.description: Maximum number of parallel compilation jobs the server will accept.

warm_jobs.description: Number of idle worker processes to keep warm for faster response.

log_level.description: Log verbosity (0 = silent, 1 = errors only, 2 = warnings, 3 = info, 4 = debug).

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file used for daemon management.

extra_args.description: Additional command-line arguments passed to distccd.

enable_standalone.description: Whether to start distccd as a standalone daemon (required for server mode).

enable_transparent.description: Enable transparent mode (distcc automatically falls back to local compilation if remote jobs fail).

disable_insecure.description: Disable insecure legacy features like IPv6 fallback and RFC 2553 compatibility for production safety.
